name: print-social-black-and-cadmium-yellow-colour-name-post
title: Sable and Cadmium Yellow Colour Post
whatItIs: A portrait post split horizontally: a black upper half with yellow 'Sable #060606' and a yellow lower half with black 'Cadmium Yellow #FDDA0D', each hex code in an outlined pill, with a social handle bar at the top.
whatItMeans: Each colour becomes its own background and its partner becomes the text, so the pairing is demonstrated as it is named.
techniques: Swap colours between halves to show contrast pairs
Hex code in an outlined pill
Large centred colour name in simple sans
Thin line and icons in the header as a subtle brand
Only two colours in the entire design

vocabulary.definition: Two colours chosen to work together.
Two areas where foreground and background swap.
A six-digit code specifying a screen colour.
